visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ question bars (#f0f0f0, plus/minus icon on the left) split into two columns; each item expands independently with an animated height
visualCharacteristics.description: No accordion variant fits: accordion-icon-grid is centered icon tiles with a shared toggle; cards-faq is static. This is a two-column list of full-width grey question bars with a left plus/minus icon, each toggling independently.

contentPattern.summary: 8 question bars (#f0f0f0, plus icon left) in two columns of 4; each bar independently expands its answer
contentPattern.structure: one row per question: (1) question text (`summary`); (2) answer rich text (`text`). The block puts the first half of the rows in the left column

reuseGuidance: Use for collapsible FAQs. For always-open Q&A boxes use cards-faq.
usageDescription: FAQ question bars (#f0f0f0, plus/minus icon on the left) split into two columns; each item expands independently with an animated height.
